summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Destina Tours & Travels resort booking site. Tested home, resort details, about, contact, policy pages, enquiry form validation + submission (window.open patched), mobile sticky CTA, drawer, image loads, and console errors. 34/41 assertions passed. Core UX (routing, form validation, WhatsApp/tel intents, mobile CTA, image assets) works. Two real gaps found: missing room-enquire-* data-testids and wa.me URL degrades to wa.me/91 because the placeholder phone contains X's (digitsOnly strips them). Most other 'failures' are false negatives caused by strict substring checks over text that spans newlines (verified visually via screenshot).
passed: Home route / renders and shows hero copy 'Escape to the hills of Wayanad.'
Header brand 'Destina Tours & Travels' and nav links Home/Land's End/About/Contact present
Header WhatsApp CTA click triggers window.open with wa.me URL + URL-encoded prefilled message referencing Destina Tours and Travels & Land's End
Hero WhatsApp button (data-testid=whatsapp-enquiry-button) triggers window.open with wa.me URL
Resort route /wayanad-resorts/lands-end-resort loads, document.title = 'Land's End Resort Wayanad Booking | Destina Tours and Travels'
All four room names render (Bungalow, Valley View, Arayum Purayum, Forest View)
Meal plans CP, MAP, AP shown on resort page
Enquiry form empty submit shows all 4 inline errors (name, phone, check-in, check-out)
Valid form submit calls window.open with wa.me URL containing URL-encoded Name/Phone/Check-in/Check-out/Room Type/Meal Plan lines
Check-out <= check-in shows 'Check-out must be after check-in' error
About page /about-us loads with 'How it works' section
Mobile 390x844: mobile-cta-whatsapp and mobile-cta-call visible; mobile-cta-call href=tel:+91XXXXXXXXXX
Hamburger toggle opens drawer with drawer-whatsapp-cta and drawer-call-cta
No 404s on the 5 customer-assets images (msk34vr8, vtpolilk, cvqtgnon, rc0gh76i, qu9nijqg)
No React runtime console errors during navigation

failed.issue: wa.me links resolve to 'https://wa.me/91?text=...' because BUSINESS.whatsapp='+91XXXXXXXXXX' and digitsOnly() strips X's, leaving only '91'. wa.me/91 is not a routable number — WhatsApp will show an invalid-number screen. tel: links are unaffected (they include the raw string). Once a real 10-digit number replaces the placeholder, this resolves automatically.
No elements match [data-testid^='room-enquire-'] on the resort page. The problem statement specifies room-enquire-* test-ids per room card; they appear to be missing (or renamed).

The 'Accommodation' nav link is present in the mobile drawer but was not detected in the desktop header rendered text at 1365x768. Needs quick visual confirmation whether desktop nav intentionally omits it or shows a different label.
failed.evidence: Desktop body inner_text did not contain 'Accommodation' at viewport 1365x768, though drawer at 390x844 shows it (screenshot).

action_items: Replace BUSINESS.whatsapp placeholder '+91XXXXXXXXXX' with a real number before launch — current wa.me/91 links won't route on WhatsApp. tel: is already fine because it uses the raw string.
Add data-testid='room-enquire-<id>' to each room card CTA on the resort page (Bungalow, Valley View, Arayum Purayum, Forest View) to match the spec.
Verify 'Accommodation' nav link on the desktop header — if it exists, make sure it renders at md+ breakpoints; if not, update the spec/expected labels.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (34/41 assertions; ~90% after excluding false-negative substring checks)
